tagline: Emoji status, badges, icons, and color accents for list and Kanban views
problem: Status fields in Odoo list and Kanban views look the same. Teams scan columns for minutes to spot paid, overdue, hot, or delayed records.
solution: Visual Enhancer is a complete UI toolkit. Map selection values to emoji and badges, add domain color rules, and highlight rows and Kanban cards without custom code.
benefits: Emoji status maps for Paid, Draft, Hot, Overdue, and custom values
Priority color rules with domains on any model
Icons, badges, and row accents in list and Kanban views
Works on sales, invoices, CRM, stock, HR, and projects
Cached evaluation for responsive list pages

features.title: Emoji status maps
features.text: Replace plain Paid or Draft text with 🟢 Paid, 📝 Draft, 🔥 Hot, and custom emoji labels.

features.title: Color rules
features.text: Define domain-based rules with priority, color, icon, emoji, and badge label.

features.title: List and Kanban accents
features.text: Row highlights and card accents make records understandable at a glance.

features.title: Any model
features.text: Configure rules and status maps for CRM, sales, invoices, stock, HR, projects, or custom apps.
